map.能耗（水/电/燃气）分摊工具按面积或表具在各业态间分摊公共能耗费用，适合商业物业: Energy (water/electricity/gas) allocation tool allocates common-area energy cost among tenants by area or meters, suitable for commercial property and office building energy cost settlement and transparency management.
map.物业把整栋公共能耗按各户用量或面积分摊: Property manager allocates whole-building common energy by each unit's usage or area
map.公共区域水电与住户自用电分开核算: Separately account for common-area utilities and tenant personal usage
map.：某户月用电 320 kWh、整栋住户总用电 4800 kWh、公共能耗总额 9: : A unit's monthly use 320 kWh, whole-building total 4800 kWh, common energy total 9600 yuan -> this unit's share 6.67%, allocated 640 yuan.
map.：无法分表的老楼按建筑面积分摊，100 ㎡户 / 总 10000 ㎡ × 公共能: : Old building without submeters allocates by floor area: 100 m^2 unit / total 10000 m^2 x common energy 9600 yuan = 96 yuan; when far from usage method, prioritize installing submeters.
map.公共能耗包含哪些？: What does common-area energy use include?
map.电梯、楼道照明、水泵、消防等公区水电，不含住户户内用电。: Elevators, corridor lighting, pumps, fire protection and other common-area utilities, excluding in-unit tenant usage.
map.用量法和面积法哪个好？: Which is better, usage method or area method?
map.有分表用量法最公平；无分表只能面积法，争议大时建议改造装表。: With submeters, usage-based allocation is fairest; without, only area method works; when disputed, retrofit with meters.
